events.name: EVENT
events.description: Declarative search event — emits UI:{event} via eventBus on query submit (alongside canonical UI:SEARCH)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-busy
overridableConfigKeys.description: This region is updating; assistive technology waits before announcing it.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-current
overridableConfigKeys.description: Marks the current item in a set: the current page, step, location, date or time.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-describedby
overridableConfigKeys.description: Id of the element whose text describes this one (help text, error).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-expanded
overridableConfigKeys.description: Whether the element it controls is expanded.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-hidden
overridableConfigKeys.description: Hide from assistive technology (decorative content only).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-label
overridableConfigKeys.description: Accessible name read by screen readers when the visible text is missing or not descriptive (e.g. an icon-only control).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-labelledby
overridableConfigKeys.description: Id of the element whose text names this one.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-live
overridableConfigKeys.description: Announce changes to this region: polite waits for a pause, assertive interrupts.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-pressed
overridableConfigKeys.description: Toggle-button state.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Aria-selected
overridableConfigKeys.description: Whether this item is selected (tabs, options, grid cells).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Class Name
overridableConfigKeys.description: Additional CSS classes

overridableConfigKeys.label: Clearable
overridableConfigKeys.description: Show clear button

overridableConfigKeys.label: Debounce Ms
overridableConfigKeys.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds

overridableConfigKeys.label: Dir
overridableConfigKeys.description: Text direction of this element's content.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Enter
overridableConfigKeys.description: How this element animates in when it mounts (theme-styled); overrides the theme's default slot entry. `none` opts out.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Enter Delay
overridableConfigKeys.description: Stagger step for the entry: waits this many `--motion-enter-stagger` steps before animating.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Event
overridableConfigKeys.description: Declarative search event — emits UI:{event} via eventBus on query submit (alongside canonical UI:SEARCH)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Is Loading
overridableConfigKeys.description: Show loading state

overridableConfigKeys.label: Lang
overridableConfigKeys.description: Language of this element's content (BCP 47, e.g. ar, sl, en).

overridableConfigKeys.label: On Search
overridableConfigKeys.description: Callback when search value changes

overridableConfigKeys.label: Placeholder
overridableConfigKeys.description: Placeholder text

overridableConfigKeys.label: Query
overridableConfigKeys.description: Query singleton binding for state management. When provided, syncs search state with the query singleton. Example: '@TaskQuery'

overridableConfigKeys.label: Role
overridableConfigKeys.description: WAI-ARIA role when the element's native semantics don't describe it.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Tab Index
overridableConfigKeys.description: 0 puts the element in the Tab order; -1 makes it focusable only programmatically.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Value
overridableConfigKeys.description: Search value (controlled mode)
